text.en:
Taking Damage while Guarding with a Sword grants Class Ability Energy:
• #e${1.5+#d}% for every point of Melee Damage Blocked
• #e${1+#f}% for every point of "other" Damage Blocked
• #e${0.5+#g}% for every point of Non-Blocked Damage (getting hit from behind)

enhanced (
var d = 0.055
var f = 0.5
var g = 0.125
#e Increases Class Ability Energy gains by an additive 0.055%, 0.5%, and 0.125% in that order.
)
